entries.title: Your Perfect Partner
entries.description: By Parallel; Hyundai Middle East & Africa; INNOCEAN MEA. Find your car like a life partner. Take a fun quiz, match your style, and discover true value with Hyundai, Your Perfect Partner. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Incredible Space
entries.description: By Vince Lee. Incredible Space is an interactive collection of procedural architectural worlds. Explore shifting structures, scrub time and follow a traveler through spaces that challenge gravity and perception, with sound and poetic field notes. Built for the browser with WebGL. An FWA Website winn

entries.title: Route 66 - Centennial
entries.description: By Unseen Studio®; Expedia Group. An immersive digital road trip celebrating 100 years of Route 66, combining editorial storytelling with interactive 3D maps to explore the people, places and stories of the Mother Road. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: DOMINIK FOJCIK — PORTFOLIO
entries.description: By Dominik Fojcik. Dominik Fojcik is an independent design engineer building websites that make ambitious startups and worldwide brands impossible to ignore An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Orchestrated
entries.description: By Orchestrated; Johan Holwerda; Mischa Loppies. I'm Joris, Motion Director from The Netherlands. For my portfolio I've built an interactive WebGL world with generative sound design. I wanted every animation and transition to feel carefully crafted, so visitors experience my work instead of only rea

entries.title: Animatronic Rehearsal
entries.description: By Geoffrey Lillemon. Animatronic Rehearsal is an operatic cat brought to life by the reconstructed jaw of a howling beast. Its movements awaken Lucrezia Bori’s 1914 recording of Mi chiamano Mimì, while the swirling of a wine glass generates a hurricane that arranges grapes into random compositions

entries.title: Design Quiz
entries.description: By dverso studio. Official playful design quiz of Caffè design Podcast, built around challenge, progress and play, generated automatically straight from their youtube videos. Enter Design Quiz. 🎯 An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: NebuLoFi
entries.description: By Profiil. Nebulofi turns a star system into an instrument. Pick a star in a living galaxy, warp in, and watch the planets arrive from deep space to settle around a living star. Every planet is a sound: move it closer or farther, change its presence and its life, call new ones in, and the music ans

entries.title: Justin Jefferson
entries.description: By Cameron Duncalfe. The official site of Justin Jefferson, wide receiver for the Minnesota Vikings. It covers his records and signature moments on the field. Off the field it covers his style, his brand partnerships and the JJets Foundation. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: ORVAE
entries.description: By Undream Studio; Gaurav Mali; Atharva Yadav. ORVAE is a website for an investment firm that backs architects, builders and real estate. You travel through five chapters of 3D architecture floating above the clouds, touch the stones of an arch, and press and hold anywhere to hear the story behind e

entries.title: Garuda 2026: The Locker Room
entries.description: By SCREENAGERS; Sulendra Pandu. A thank-you to Timnas Indonesia, FIFA ASEAN Cup 2026 champions. Scroll the trophy through 24 posters by 24 Indonesian artists, then step into The Locker Room where every shirt hangs. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Adrien Quéchon 2026 Website
entries.description: By Okey Studio; Clarisse Michard; Adrien Quechon. Adrien Quéchon, a French freelance creative developer, presents his 2026 website. Co-founder of Okey Studio. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Oh là là Ride
entries.description: By The Officin. A small playable ride through Paris, built with Three.js, with 1v1 matchmaking. You can also invite a friend to play! Enjoy the ride! An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: The Aviator
entries.description: By EPIC Agency; Yakudoo. The Aviator is a browser game with two ways to fly. Chill mode is about dodging trouble, and it's harder than it sounds. Shoot'em up mode hands you the guns and fills the sky with enemies and explosions. Enjoy the chaos and challenge your friends. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: No Mercy Michel
entries.description: By Merci-Michel. You thought we where nice people... An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Dream with AI
entries.description: By Hello Monday/DEPT®. Can an AI feel anything? If it could, what would it dream? Every night an AI dreams up a whole new world, with its own visuals and soundscapes. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: JUNKYARD KING | Chapter 3: The Other Side
entries.description: By Odd Kid. Artie, Kai and Socket have made it through the gate and into Avalon. What they expected to be a dark and dangerous world turns out to be strangely beautiful. But as they venture deeper in search of Emily, they quickly discover that looks can be deceiving. An FWA AI winner.

entries.title: EXPERIENCE FUNTECH CREATIVITY
entries.description: By FunTech Inc.. An immersive website where you can experience FunTech's creativity. Explore FunTech's technology and ideas hands-on, together with our official character, Fun-kun. Play ten real-time 3D scenes: switch his looks, call down lightning, dance in a neon alley and knock until he breaks ou

entries.title: The Lantern House
entries.description: By Dwayne Koh. The Lantern House is an immersive WebGL portfolio where a lantern-lit pavilion unfolds into interactive worlds for global brands, blending cinematic storytelling, handcrafted detail, responsive motion, and in-depth case studies. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Night Drive Racing Game
entries.description: By Anderson Mancini dos Santos. A free-to-play racing game built with Three.js and WebGPU. Explore a huge city, complete 50+ missions, drift through rainy streets, collect items and drive multiple cars. Featuring realistic rendering, physics, reflections and custom WebGPU techniques, on desktop and

entries.title: Awards Racing
entries.description: By Ecofuture. A browser drift-racer built with three.js and Bullet physics, mixing arcade racing with vehicular combat in a design-world setting: a young nominee racing to the top, dodging angry jurors and rivals. Physics-driven VFX, stage progression, and beat-synced characters. An FWA Website winn

entries.title: Wipeout The Movie — Concept Trailer
entries.description: By Robert Lindström. Movie concept. Exploring AI-generated film, design, and sound. Created with Midjourney 7, Eleven Labs and Gemini 2.5. An FWA AI winner.

entries.title: Paodao
entries.description: By Jérôme Reynet. Paodao is an interactive portfolio transformed into a playful game-like experience where projects are discovered through exploration. It brings together real-time techniques such as procedural environments, parallax occlusion and gameplay mechanics to create an immersive digital jo

entries.title: Stuff by Kris Temmerman
entries.description: By Kris Temmerman. It's a Portfolio! It's a Pirate Game! An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Sleep Well Creative
entries.description: By Victor Work. Sleep Well Creatives is an interactive web experience designed to help people and improve the quality of their sleep through science-based insights, friendly design, and visuals. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: illoca
entries.description: By Unseen Studio®. illoca is an AI-native design engine built for professional architects. Explore, refine, and move from first ideas to editable 2D and 3D designs. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Santioni Spirits: The Notturno Experience
entries.description: By Active Theory; Plan8. "The Notturno Experience" invites visitors into the illustrated universe of Santioni Spirits. An immersive, comic book-inspired journey serving as the brand's introduction to the world. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Why Zero
entries.description: By Zero Design; Sindhur Dutta; Atul Khola. Why Zero is an immersive story about how Zero University replaces the broken education system with AI, real projects and real jobs at top companies. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Lacoste Ace Breaker
entries.description: By Merci-Michel. Play and break as many bricks as you can to win tickets to Roland Garros and Lacoste polo shirts. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: IVRESS SPIN A TALE
entries.description: By Utsubo; Laugh Mind. Where human connections meet storytelling — the philosophy of IVRESS, woven into the future. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Shader Development Studio
entries.description: By Shader Development Studio. Creative development studio building interactive 3D and AI solutions. Working with brands and agencies worldwide. Plugged into the future. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Oryzo AI
entries.description: By Lusion. A cinematic product story that turns an ordinary cork coaster into an immersive digital experience through craft, detail, and interaction. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Explore Primland
entries.description: By Outpost; Ingamana; Robert Borghesi; Robbin Cenijn; Matyáš Sochor. Capturing the magic of the Blue Ridge Mountains in an immersive digital experience available to everyone, everywhere. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: The Renaissance Edition
entries.description: By Shopify Design. Shopify's Winter ’26 Edition features 150+ product updates for a new world of commerce. Updates are beautifully set against the backdrop of 3D paintings that mix Renaissance art with modern elements. An FWA Website winner.

entries.title: Possession of Chess
entries.description: By Geoffrey Lillemon. Possession of chess by Geoffrey Lillemon 2025 is a browser based WebGL system made for the oculartv2 website that uses machine-learning to control two monarchical ghosts in a real-time chess game. An FWA Website winner.
